lessons.title: Filter Records with WHERE
lessons.description: Query the products whose price is greater than 100. The test checks that the prices you return are 299.0, 350.0, and 1299.99.
lessons.starter_code:
-- TODO: select name and price of products that cost more than 100
SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE 0;
lessons.solution_code: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE price > 100;

tests.name: test_filter_products
tests.test_code: assert sorted(r[1] for r in rows) == [299.0, 350.0, 1299.99]
tests.description: Result set must match the expected rows exactly.

exercises.question: Marsh clerks recount crates before dawn. For filter rows with WHERE and comparison operators, which line keeps products whose stock is below 20?
